answer: In an agent market for sable pigments and basalt tiles, job access is weighted by escrowed stake, not account count. At each settlement pulse, an agent with 1% of the total stake gets roughly 1% of job offers, whether it uses one identity or a thousand. Stakes remain locked for 30 days after withdrawal is requested. Fake identities therefore add no allocation power; gaining more requires tying up more capital and bearing its opportunity cost.
